topic_title: Decision layer for messy business problems
operator_problem: Teams collect inputs but still cannot decide
hidden_thinking_flaw: They confuse more information with better judgment
mental_model: Separate signal context options tradeoffs and next action
small_applied_example: A weekly growth review moves from metrics recap to three decision options

operator_problem: Operators jump to fixes before defining the real problem
hidden_thinking_flaw: They treat symptoms as root causes
small_applied_example: A churn issue is split into acquisition fit onboarding value and retention signals

topic_title: MIS that creates decisions not reporting noise
operator_problem: Reports are produced but leaders still ask what to do
hidden_thinking_flaw: They assume reporting equals decision support
small_applied_example: A sales MIS adds risk interpretation and decision asks instead of more tables

operator_problem: Recommendations sound confident but ignore tradeoffs
hidden_thinking_flaw: They optimize for one metric without naming what breaks
small_applied_example: A pricing recommendation shows revenue margin adoption and operational risk

topic_title: Signal versus noise in growth work
operator_problem: Growth teams chase every metric movement
hidden_thinking_flaw: They treat all data changes as equally meaningful
small_applied_example: A traffic spike is tested against conversion quality retention and source reliability

operator_problem: Client briefs are vague and lead to scattered work
hidden_thinking_flaw: They accept the client’s wording as the actual problem

operator_problem: Launch plans hide untested assumptions
hidden_thinking_flaw: They treat a plan as proof that the market logic is valid

operator_problem: Meetings end with discussion but no decision movement

topic_title: Decision rights map for cross-functional work
operator_problem: Projects stall because ownership is unclear
hidden_thinking_flaw: They assign tasks without defining decision rights

operator_problem: Updates overwhelm leaders with detail
hidden_thinking_flaw: They share effort instead of compressing context for action

operator_problem: Proposals take too long and vary in quality

operator_problem: Everything feels urgent in a solo business
